title: HONOR 600S officially goes on sale nationwide as first-ever Alpha Store opens at SM Megamall
summary: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines officially marks the first-day sale of the HONOR 600S, making the latest addition to the HONOR 600 Series available to more Filipino consumers through…

blocks.text: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines officially marks the first-day sale of the HONOR 600S, making the latest addition to the HONOR 600 Series available to more Filipino consumers through authorized HONOR stores, partner dealers, and official online channels nationwide. The milestone also coincides with the opening of the new HONOR Alpha Store at SM Megamall Cyberzone, which features a service center to provide customers with added convenience and support.

blocks.caption: SM Megamall’s Assistant Mall Manager Isabella Manjon with HONOR Philippines’ Go-To-Market Director Steven Yan and Vice President Stephen Cheng.

blocks.text: Designed for users who balance work, entertainment, and content creation, the HONOR 600S brings together long-lasting battery life, durable protection, and AI-powered features in one smartphone.

“We’re excited to bring the HONOR 600S to more Filipino consumers as it officially becomes available nationwide,” said Stephen Cheng, Vice President of HONOR Philippines. “With its powerful battery, durable design, and intelligent features, the HONOR 600S is designed to keep up with the different ways people use their smartphones, from staying connected and getting work done to creating content and enjoying entertainment.”

The HONOR 600S features an 8,100mAh battery with 45W HONOR SuperCharge, along with IP68, IP69, and IP69K water and dust resistance. Its Cushioning and Fall Protection Architecture has earned the SGS Premium Performance Certification for Drop and Crush Resistance, including a 5-Star All-Round Drop Resistance rating and tested drop protection of up to 2.5 meters under controlled laboratory conditions.

For content creation, the smartphone features a dedicated AI Button and HONOR AI Image to Video 2.0, allowing users to transform still images into dynamic video content. It is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 Mobile Platform and features a 6.87-inch 120Hz display, 400% Volume Dual Speakers, and a 50MP main camera.

The HONOR 600S comes in Velvet Black, Desert Gold, and Misty Purple. The 8GB + 256GB is available for only PHP 19,999 until October 31, 2026, with a free HONOR Bluetooth Speaker II for those who made the pre-order and an HONOR Watch 2i for those who made the first-day purchases. The 6GB + 128GB variant is available online exclusively for PHP 18,999 with a free HONOR Watch 2i. Customers can also enjoy online exclusive offers on Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop subject to applicable platform promotions and terms.
Last Chance to Register for the PHP 1 Million Shopping Spree Promo

Customers who pre-ordered or purchased the HONOR 600S can still join the HONOR 600S PHP 1 Million Shopping Spree Promo, as HONOR Philippines has extended the registration deadline to October 18, 2026, giving eligible customers more time to register for a chance to win PHP 1 million worth of shopping spree at SM Stores, subject to the official promo mechanics.
For the full promo mechanics and registration details, visit www.honorphrafflepromo.com.
